$description: Closed value set for each capability primitive. Used by ArchetypeInstance.capabilities when the LLM composes a module from primitives (as opposed to picking a recipe). See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-11-intelligent-rich-forge.md.

read.pattern.description: How primary data of this module is presented.

read.grouping.description: How rows/cards are grouped for scanning.

write.pattern.description: How writes happen in this module.

presentation.itemShape.description: The visual atom rendered per record.

state.realtime.description: Freshness strategy for the module's data.

safe_defaults.$comment: Used by archetype_recipe_detector.py as last-resort fallback when LLM emits invalid capabilities. Conservative crud-like defaults.
